Cain. * Full text (40 Ko) * Red and blue only * Red only

   

MIND. [1] [Cain.]
Weeping with cough.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cain.]
Inflammation of eyes, with fluent coryza.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Cain.]
Polyuria of some months' duration.
Copious urination after drinking coffee.
   

COUGH. [27] [Cain.]
Attacks of rough coughing from 7 P. M. till 1 A. M., with rattling of phlegm and short breath ; accumulation of wind in abdomen, which feels like a pair of bellows set in motion ; feels it putting hands there.
Cough with weeping.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Cain.]
Somnolence.
   

SKIN. [46] [Cain.]
Dry skin with hydrops.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Cain.]
Cainca 30 three doses taken at eight-day intervals after Arsenic had given some relief. θ Hydrothorax with œdema of feet.
